chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Wealth is an excellent aid in attaining taqwa toward Allah.

key_terms.تَقْوَى: Taqwa; God-conscious piety and guarding oneself through obedience
key_terms.رَسُولُ: Messenger; referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.نِعْمَ: Excellent; expressing praise for something beneficial
key_terms.ٱللَّهِ: Allah, the One toward Whom taqwa is directed
key_terms.ٱلْعَوْنُ: Aid or assistance in achieving a goal
key_terms.ٱلْغِنَى: Wealth or sufficiency; material means that can support piety

ai.seo_question: How does wealth help a believer attain taqwa?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that wealth, when used properly, can be a strong means of supporting taqwa and obedience to Allah. It presents material means not as an end in themselves, but as a tool that can assist a believer in living a pious life.
